chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality Chapter 313 – Demonic Transformation
chapter_meta_description: The bald giant undergoes a terrifying demonic transformation, tearing through Han Li’s best magic tool. Forced to retreat, Han Li must prepare his Talisman Treasure while his allies hold the line.
og_title: The Bald Giant Becomes a Monster – RMJI Chapter 313
og_description: The bald giant tears through the Sky-Covering Bell and emerges as a demonic horror. Han Li is forced to reach for his final trump card.
twitter_description: Han Li’s capture mission goes sideways when his prisoner becomes a demonic nightmare. Only the Talisman Treasure can save him now.

lore_anchors.definition: A state where a cultivator’s body is overtaken by a bestial or demonic nature, losing all humanity and becoming a vessel for pure slaughter. Often triggered by forbidden techniques or extreme pressure.

A one-time-use magical treasure sealed into a talisman format, allowing a lower-level cultivator to access the power of a high-grade artifact. It requires a dedicated casting time and costs significant mana.
Han Li’s durable, bell-shaped magic tool used for trapping and sealing enemies. Its destruction signals that the demonic transformation has pushed the enemy’s power beyond the tool’s limit.
A defensive magic tool providing a pale white barrier. It is strong enough to take several direct blows from high-level demonic attacks but is not indestructible.
A group of four rogue cultivators temporarily allied with Han Li. They are increasingly awed by his power and are forced to cooperate to survive.

A mechanical or alchemical construct shaped like a beast, used as a combat unit. Controlled by the cultivator’s mana, they are useful for sustained barrages but lack the raw power of top-grade magic tools.
